items.summary: Recommend maintaining containment-only execution. Revenue support is limited to Amazon’s 2026-09-21 aggregate result: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The 18 named tracking rows show $0 site-attributed income; the aggregate row cannot be assigned to any site without inventing attribution. Do not claim site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, forecast, or causal lift. AI usage cost is $928.5425623 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29, which does not match the one-day revenue period. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, labor and operating costs, commitments, budget exposure, and learning thresholds are unknown—not zero. The 14,410 SEO impressions, 146 clicks, 998 sessions, 15 conversions, 3 proven outcomes, and 42 improvements awaiting measurement are prioritization or delivery metrics, not financial performance. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation, attribution review, measurement, repair-or-close, owner-gap, legal, and security evidence work. Do not approve new spend, monetization expansion, forecasts, requeues, or production work.

The minimum finance artifact is a period-aligned reconciliation for 2026-09-21 covering every named tracking row plus the aggregate row, with site/content identifiers, clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, matching-period AI cost, infrastructure cost, labor and other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved cost-to-learn threshold. Until those fields exist, margin and budget capacity cannot be calculated. Do not treat unavailable costs or attribution as zero, and do not extrapolate one-day revenue or September AI spend into monthly forecasts.
